notes:
Passed on the fake backend with python3 -m mhs.driver check (exit 0); evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware backend is declared and no hardware run was made. The repository registers Isaac Lab Gymnasium tasks; the card's entry symbols are the flat and rough config classes. This package serves the flat task Template-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-Anymal-D-v0 (env_cfg AnymalDFlatEnvCfg); the rough config is its parent and is not separately served. The upstream needs Isaac Sim 4.0.0 and Isaac Lab v1.0.0 with a GPU (README.md:30-32) and was not installed or run. The fake backend is the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in (F0), not the upstream simulator: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors, terrain or noise, and no trajectory was compared with the upstream environment. Its array shapes follow the clone's ANYmal-D sample: 12 action values and, for the flat task, 48 observation values. The sample observation is 235 values including a height scan (exts/StrideSim/StrideSim/anymal_articulation.py:144), and the flat task removes the height_scan term (rl/StrideSim_RL/tasks/locomotion/velocity/config/anymal_d/flat_env_cfg.py:21), leaving the first 48 values; the values are synthetic, projected gravity is fixed, the base pose is not observed and the action Box is unbounded because the real action bound lives outside the clone. All of this is in the fidelity gaps. Six warning kinds are expected and explained: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset and makes no native call); five G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close, because native is the card's config class and the Gymnasium environment surface comes from the external ManagerBasedRLEnvCfg base; four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer and numeric inputs the bridge derives; and G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because the fake action space is unbounded (the real bound is outside the clone), so there is no limit to probe and no bound was invented. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. The lock keeps the card's install block (Python bound from rl/setup.py:32 and a note on the README's rl/ install) and its backends are the class's {"fake": ".fake:FakeAnymalDEnv"}.
